cases.sentence: Поэтому пусть мои ___ найдут у тебя расположение, ведь мы пришли в праздничный день.
cases.explain: «молодые люди» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Therefore let the young men find favor in your eyes; for we come on a good day. Please give whatever comes to your hand, to your servants, and to your son David.’ ”

cases.sentence: Поэтому пусть мои молодые люди найдут у тебя расположение, ведь мы пришли в ___.
cases.explain: «праздничный день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Therefore let the young men find favor in your eyes; for we come on a good day. Please give whatever comes to your hand, to your servants, and to your son David.’ ”

cases.sentence: Он такой ___, что никто не может с ним говорить.
cases.explain: «злобный человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his house; for he is such a worthless fellow that one can’t speak to him.”

cases.sentence: Она взяла двести лепешек, два бурдюка с вином, пять приготовленных овец, пять мер ___, сто связок изюма, двести связок сушеного инжира и нагрузила все это на ослов.
cases.explain: «жареного зерна» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, two containers of wine, five sheep ready dressed, five seahs of parched grain, one hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on donkeys.

cases.sentence: Пусть мой господин не обращает внимания на этого ___ Навала.
cases.explain: «негодного человека» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Please don’t let my lord pay attention to this worthless fellow, Nabal; for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his name, and folly is with him; but I, your servant, didn’t see my lord’s young men, whom you sent.

cases.sentence: Пожалуйста, прости вину твоей служанки, ведь Господь непременно создаст для моего господина ___, потому что мой господин ведет войны Господа.
cases.explain: «прочный дом» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Please forgive the trespass of your servant. For Yahweh will certainly make my lord a sure house, because my lord fights Yahweh’s battles. Evil will not be found in you all your days.
